title: WATCH: How To Use Your Sony Camera As Your Webcam for Live-Streaming
summary: Learn how to setup your Sony camera as your webcam for virtual meetings and more.
body_markdown:
https://alphauniverseglobal.media.zestyio.com/Alpha-Universe-Jason-Vong-Livestream-Sony-Camera-1.jpg?width=500&height=500&fit=bounds


Virtual livestreams are a popular way to communicate right now during social distancing. Business meetings, happy hours, workshops – everything has moved online so we can continue to interact while staying at home. You can very easily level up your online livestream game by using your Sony camera as your webcam. It's simple to do, you don't need much, and the image quality it produces is much higher than that of your laptop's built-in webcam. In the video below, watch as Jason Vong shows you step-by-step how to livestream through your Sony camera. You can also read how to do it in[How To Use Your Sony Alpha And RX Cameras For Live-Streaming](https://alphauniverse.com/stories/how-to-use-your-sony-alpha-and-rx-cameras-for-livestreaming/) and listen to it explained in the latest[Alpha Universe Podcast](https://alphauniverse.com/podcasts/paul-gero-joins-the-podcast-to-talk-about-portraits-in-the-time-of-corona/) .
